name: Kaizhang la, Weixiao Coffee Ting
original_name: 開張啦 微笑咖啡廳
source:
The summer heat has reached its peak, and the air conditioner in your apartment seems to have stopped working properly. How will you, a freelance artist, solve this problem?!
You decide to take all your drawing equipment and go to enjoy the coolness at the “Smile” café, where you start unusual relationships with different women.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3116500/Leto_v_uyutnom_kafe_Smajl/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
盛夏酷暑已攀至顶峰，而你公寓里的空调偏偏在这时候罢工失灵了。身为自由插画师的你该如何解决这个难题？！
你决定带上全套绘画设备，前往凉爽宜人的“微笑”咖啡厅避暑办公，并在那里与形形色色的女性展开了一段段非同寻常的邂逅。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3116500/Leto_v_uyutnom_kafe_Smajl/]Steam[/url]]
